title: House alignment and dimensions decision — assigned account, source-limited
citation: Assigned citation: Cour de cassation,3e civ., November 17, 1977, Bull.III no.392; identity unverified
lead: A small departure from agreed house dimensions prompts a demand for correction; the assignment reports cassation of the refusal but leaves the complete judgment unidentified.

actors.name: The homeowner
actors.role: Unnamed party seeking compliance with agreed house dimensions.

actors.name: The builder
actors.role: Unnamed counterparty responsible for the nonconforming construction described in the assignment.

proceedings: The assigned account reports a lower decision refusing corrective modifications.
It reports that the Court of Cassation quashed that refusal; exact remand and remedy remain unknown.
limits: The complete actual judgment and supplied citation have not been independently recovered or confirmed. Parties, measurements, full procedure, quoted Code text, scope of cassation, remand, costs, author and votes remain unresolved.

review.basis: Individually written and compared with the canonical full brief; no new independent opinion audit claimed.

sections.title: The completed house departs slightly from the promised dimensions
sections.cue: What does the assignment actually describe?
paragraphs: The assigned chapter describes a house built slightly out of alignment with its contractually specified dimensions. It does not name the homeowner or builder, quantify the departure or reproduce the contract.
The account concerns enforcement of the promised construction configuration. It supplies no basis to borrow the measurements or parties from the neighboring house-height or swimming-pool cases.

sections.title: The homeowner’s request for corrective modifications is refused below
sections.cue: What ground does the chapter identify as the problem?
paragraphs: A lower decision refused to compel corrective modifications. The chapter reports that the Court of Cassation treated the minimal nature of the difference between promised and actual work as irrelevant to that refusal.

The assignment uses the example to illustrate the historical strength of enforcing contractual specifications even where a defect appeared small. It does not give the lower court’s date, the exact requested works or the complete statutory reasoning of either court.

sources.pinpoint: Reported procedure and attributed rationale; printed 204 & n.60

sections.title: The reported refusal is quashed without a known final correction order
sections.cue: Which result can be stated and which remains unavailable?
paragraphs: The chapter says the Court of Cassation quashed the refusal and cites the Third Civil Chamber, November 17, 1977, Bulletin III no.392. That citation remains an unverified identity lead because the full actual judgment has not been recovered.

The account does not establish the scope of cassation, the remand court, costs or a final reconstruction order. Nearby scholarly debate about later proportionality reform is not a separate opinion in this case and does not show that the 1977 court applied the later rule.

sources.pinpoint: Reported cassation and source limits; printed 204 & nn.60–63
